entities.summary: The Basilica of Our Lady of El Valle It is a Gothic Revival basilica located in El Valle del Espíritu Santo a town on the island of Margarita, of Nueva Esparta state, in northwestern Venezuela. Its name is in honor of the patron saint of the town and the Venezuelan Navy: the Virgen del Valle.
